review: Blade Lineage Meursault used to be a “Godsent” ID, got powercrept afterwards, and now, thanks to Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀] E.G.O and actually competent Blade Lineage Identity, which is LCD OSIR Team Ishmael, he claims his way to “relevance” again. Said E.G.O. makes him a double-status ID, which is mostly relevant for MD. More importantly, it boosts his damage and rolls into “current standards” as of the day of the review. Of course, he won’t match the damage of House of Spiders Yi Sang or Outis, but at least it is sitting on a respectable level. Unfortunately for him, Blade Lineage did not get a “buff” as a whole. While E.G.O buffs BL to a certain degree, their kits did not age well, and it shows.
